title: Borzsa
summary: The Borzhava, also known as Borzsa in Hungarian, is a significant right tributary of the Tisza River located in the [[transcarpathia|Zakarpattia]] Oblast of western Ukraine. It plays an important role in the region's hydrology and geography.

sections.heading: Geographical Overview
paragraphs: The Borzhava river rises in the Eastern [[carpathians|Carpathians]], contributing to the diverse landscape of [[western-ukraine|western Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Hydrological Characteristics
paragraphs: The river has a basin that spans an area of 1,450 km2 (560 sq mi), indicating its significance in the local ecosystem and water management.

sections.heading: Confluence with Tisza
paragraphs: The Borzhava discharges into the Tisza River near the town of Vary, which is situated on the border with Hungary, highlighting its role in cross-border hydrology.
